issues: Missing mileage logging implementation – no model, store, UI screens (MileageScreen, MileageEntryScreen), or MileageCard component, and no functions to compute mileage deduction.
DashboardScreen does not display mileage deduction or estimated tax summary cards as required by the spec; only income and expenses are shown.
Export functionality is absent – there are no exportCsv.ts or exportPdf.ts modules, no ExportScreen, and no ExportButton component to generate and share CSV/PDF files.

Backup and restore feature is not implemented – missing src/lib/backup.ts, BackupScreen, RestoreScreen, BackupButton, RestoreButton and the associated encryption/key‑derivation logic for encrypted backups.

App lock (biometric authentication) is not present – src/lib/appLock.ts is missing, App.tsx never prompts for Face ID/Touch ID, and SettingsScreen only stores a toggle without any actual lock behavior.
Settings are incomplete – only an app‑lock toggle exists; there are no UI or storage for mileageRate, taxRate, export, backup/restore, view policy, or delete‑all‑data actions.
Receipt photo capture is not implemented – no expo-image-picker integration, no photoUri handling in ReceiptEntryScreen, and no UI for attaching photos to receipts.

Several files listed in the plan are missing (e.g., src/lib/mileageStore.ts, src/lib/mileage.ts, src/lib/settings.ts, src/lib/appLock.ts, src/lib/exportCsv.ts, src/lib/exportPdf.ts, src/screens/MileageScreen.tsx, src/screens/MileageEntryScreen.tsx, src/screens/ExportScreen.tsx, src/screens/BackupScreen.tsx, src/screens/RestoreScreen.tsx, src/components/ui/MileageCard.tsx, src/components/ui/ExportButton.tsx, src/components/ui/BackupButton.tsx, src/components/ui/RestoreButton.tsx) which would cause build failures if referenced.
Unit and integration tests for the required pure‑logic modules (finance, mileage, backup, settings, appLock) are missing; only basic template tests are present.

The overall feature set defined in the task (tax estimation, configurable mileage rate, encrypted on‑device storage usage, UI polish, accessibility compliance beyond current scope) is not fully realized.
feedback: The current codebase passes the minimal acceptance tests but only implements a small subset of the required functionality. Major features such as mileage tracking, export, backup/restore, biometric app lock, full settings management, receipt photo capture, and comprehensive testing are missing. The solution needs to be expanded to include all listed components and behaviours before it can be considered complete.
